agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technology significance and bounded application implications

analytical_question: Should management authorize a bounded research-summary pilot, and should the technology's broader significance change that decision?
general_et_finding: Prospective mode. Unit: deployed general-purpose generative AI language-model systems, not all AI, a single model component, or one vendor. Classification: Potential Promethean, qualified; moderate confidence in the candidate label and low confidence in eventual civilization-scale confirmation. Demonstrated significance is at least breakthrough; permanent cross-tier transformation is unproven. Barrier statement: before these systems, open-ended language drafting and interactive explanations generally required a person to formulate each new response; this was treated as part of cognitive work. Earlier automation already existed, so this is not a claim that AI invented automated text. Generating new responses without a person composing each one suggests partial removal of that constraint, while verification and accountability still require people. Suppression test: removal of this technology class would restore substantial human drafting and explanation work; the checked sources do not establish collapse of essential systems. Full dissolution is not confirmed. The Potential label follows Chapter 11's prospective treatment, explicitly as a hypothesis rather than a passed strict retrospective gate. Tiers: workplace production provides economic evidence; educational tutoring provides cognitive/social evidence. Different occupations alone are not different tiers. Biological survival dissolution is not established. Six criteria are diagnostic, not a passed gate or additive score: (1) order-of-magnitude: not demonstrated by the checked sources; no common baseline establishes 10x; (2) widespread impact: partial, with evidence in work and education but not society-wide dissolution; (3) paradigm shift: partial, because response generation can be separated from human composition, while responsibility remains human; (4) catalytic effect: partial, illustrated by a purpose-built tutor but not proof of a dependent innovation wave; (5) democratizing effect: partial, because access to assistance may broaden but affordability, language and digital access remain unmeasured; (6) irreversibility: unresolved, with no demonstrated durable cross-tier infrastructure dependence. Strict full Promethean confirmation must be withheld.
application_finding: For internal summaries, expected significance is mainly incremental workflow improvement: assistance with drafting does not eliminate source checking or analyst responsibility. A useful pilot could save effort, but no measured bank benefit is available. The local application does not inherit civilization-changing status.
organization_specific_finding: The hypothetical fast-follower bank can learn through a limited public-document pilot because trained reviewers and an approved workspace are assumed. The uncertain benefit and consequential research errors justify staged scope and named analyst sign-off.

evidence.claim: Chapter 11 offers a system/barrier/suppression framework, six criteria, and a prospective Potential Promethean ceiling for generative AI.
evidence.source_or_reference: Fortino, Chapter 11, Identifying Promethean Technologies, August 2026 draft Rev 0.1, sections 11.2 and 11.7, pp. 3-4 and 8-11; supplied course PDF.
evidence.notes: Conceptual classification, not independent empirical proof. The draft leaves tension between the strict suppression gate and prospective AI example.

evidence.claim: A randomized writing experiment found lower task time and higher rated quality with ChatGPT.
evidence.notes: Primary publisher abstract was searchable; full-page opening failed. Evidence supports bounded writing assistance, not bank ROI or civilization-scale 10x gains.

evidence.claim: A 2023 consulting experiment found benefits on selected tasks and worse correctness on an outside-frontier task.
evidence.date_or_recency: Dell'Acqua et al., 2023 working paper, abstract p. 2; read 2026-10-22
evidence.notes: Supports both opportunity and task-dependent limits; old GPT-4 results do not measure every 2026 system or autonomous financial advice.

evidence.claim: A custom AI-tutoring randomized trial reported greater learning in less time in its tested setting.
evidence.date_or_recency: Kestin et al., 2025; author-lab abstract read 2026-10-22
evidence.evidence_type: Original study abstract on author institution site
evidence.notes: Adds cognitive/educational evidence beyond workplace production. Does not prove all tutors work, equitable access, or irreversible education dependence.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The checked studies show bounded outcomes, not society-wide 10x improvement or irreversible dependence.
Task-dependent errors and continued human review challenge the strongest barrier-dissolution claim.
A tutoring deployment supports a second tier hypothesis; it does not establish education-wide transformation.
Organizational capabilities and controls are scenario assumptions; no actual bank or hotel was tested.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a qualified Potential Promethean hypothesis under Chapter 11; low confidence in eventual confirmation. Local net benefits, current model performance and control effectiveness are unmeasured. The older studies establish historical evidence only. No exhaustive state-of-the-art claim is made.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially reduce internal drafting effort and free analyst attention, conditional on verification costs.
risk_governance_implication: Keep public inputs, source traceability and analyst approval; no automatic client delivery or trading.
recommendation_management_implication: Authorize only an eight-week, internal public-document pilot if the stated workspace and reviewer assumptions are confirmed. Compare reviewed drafts with manual summaries on matched documents; record total drafting plus verification time, unsupported consequential claims and reviewer workload. Analyst approval is required for every circulated summary. Proposed management gate: scale only after positive net time savings with no deterioration in reviewed factual quality; stop on any uncorrected consequential error or data incident. These are proposed controls, not measured results or regulatory standards.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess broad classification if independently replicated evidence shows roughly 10x improvement on a defined dimension and genuine multi-tier barrier removal.
Reassess on durable cross-tier infrastructure dependence, or evidence that fallback remains straightforward and effects plateau.
Reassess the local decision when matched-task results, control readiness, incident history or review costs change; revisit broad significance annually.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold Confirmed Promethean: long-run irreversibility and strict suppression evidence are missing.
Do not certify safe autonomous use, financial suitability, compliance, or realized ROI.
Confirm the hypothetical organization's actual capabilities and obtain local task-specific results before scaling.
